ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Impacts leave burning zones and amplify weapon damage against burning targets.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Trades immediate meteor impact for persistent fire zones and stronger follow-up damage.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Concentrates every meteor on the highest-health target.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Extreme single-target and armor-breaking pressure replaces most swarm coverage.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Covers the lane with smaller impacts that apply vulnerability.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Amplifies later area damage while sacrificing direct boss damage.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Weapon hits during the storm build attack speed and damage.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: The ultimate empowers the primary weapon instead of dealing an independent burst.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Repeated storm hits pin, slow, and briefly stun enemies.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Control replaces part of the storm damage and is weaker against resistant bosses.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Concentrates fire on marked or highest-health targets.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Repeated hits execute priority targets but lose most area coverage when targets change.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Frozen enemies become brittle and shatter under weapon hits.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Converts control into explosive follow-up while shortening the global freeze.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Creates a long slowing field that extends status duration.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Provides sustained control and damage-over-time value with minimal immediate damage.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Slowed targets chain electric damage between one another.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Rewards clustered enemies and Arcane or electric follow-up, but loses value when targets spread.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Pulls enemies into a persistent area-damage kill zone.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Amplifies area and status damage but rewinds enemies less far.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Rewinds advanced enemies farther and restores cooldowns.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: A defensive utility evolution with low direct damage and a cooldown-restoration cap.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Collapses gravity onto one target for focused damage.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Redirects nearby enemies and projectiles into a priority target, sacrificing broad control.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Temporarily empowers the equipped weapon module.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Improves attack rate and status application while the surge itself loses global burst damage.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Damage jumps farther when enemies carry active statuses.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: Mixed status builds gain chain value but isolated targets receive less benefit.

ultimate_evolutions.short_description: Consumes stored energy for a massive boss execute hit.
ultimate_evolutions.long_description: A high-impact finisher with the longest cooldown that resets supportive buffs.
